package.name: uav_swarm_msgs
package.description: Custom ROS2 message types for the BFT UAV swarm validation testbed. Mirrors the four core inter-UAV primitives defined in BFT_UAV_Swarm_Paper_v9_8 §IV-B / §IV-D: - SignedObservation (Visual Proof of Observation) - DistilledState (per-UAV broadcast tuple) - NoisyPose (noise-stamped pose used by relay / reputation prior) - ReputationUpdate (audit trail of every reputation change)
